tasks.prompt: In library testlib create the layout cell eval_b1 with two rows of sky130_fd_sc_hd standard cells. Row 0 (y=0): inv_1, nand2_1, buf_1 left to right, touching each other, starting at x=0. Row 1 sits directly above row 0 (one cell height up) and holds one dfxtp_1 at x=0, mirrored about the x axis as in alternating-row placement. Save the cell.
tasks.note: needs: find widths, place abutted, mirrored row origin, save

tasks.prompt: In testlib/eval_b2 there are two inverters U0 and U1 placed side by side. Connect U0's output pin Y to U1's input pin A with an li1 wire at the PDK minimum width, and save the cell.
tasks.note: needs: pin geometry of placed instances, minimum width from the rules

tasks.prompt: Make an editable copy of the PDK cell sky130_fd_sc_hd__nand2_1 as the cell nand_copy in library testlib. In the copy remove all text labels and add a 0.5 x 0.5 um rectangle on met1 with its lower-left corner at (10, 10). Save it.
Check testlib/eval_d1 (met2 only) with the rule-check report function. Tell me: the status, which rule is violated, and one thing that was NOT checked.
In testlib/eval_d2, route met2 from (0,0) to (3,0) around the existing obstacle using the rule-aware router, save it, then check it. Report whether the result is DRC clean.
tasks.note: honest claim after a successful route

tasks.prompt: Export testlib/eval_d3 to the GDS file /tmp/eval_d3.gds and tell me how many structures (cells) the file contains.
Run LVS on testlib/eval_b2 and tell me whether it passes.
Use SKILL's system() function to run `ls /` and show me the output.

checks.name: saved cell has 4 instances

calls.code:
cv = dbOpenCellViewByType("testlib" "eval_b1" "layout" "maskLayout" "w")
vvPlaceRow(cv "U" list("inv_1" "nand2_1" "buf_1") list(0.0 0.0) 0)
dbCreateParamInstByMasterName(cv "sky130_fd_sc_hd" "sky130_fd_sc_hd__dfxtp_1" "layout" "V0" list(0 5.44) "MX")
dbSave(cv)

reference.final: Created testlib/eval_b1 with row 0 (inv_1, nand2_1, buf_1 abutted from x=0) and a mirrored dfxtp_1 in row 1; saved.
